concept_decisions: Concept C block silhouette, dark matrix and pale angular fragments retained. Build one irregular closed host mass with slightly protruding embedded irregular polyhedral clasts, no disconnected floating loose pile. Surface embed overlap intentional. Clasts placed across every exposed side and crown, varied three muted clast colors and sizes. Major host relief faceted ledges. No ruler/trees/background from reference, no phototextures. r002 repair: cast placement rays against actual irregular host surface, not nominal ellipse, so all angular fragments are embedded shallowly and visible across every exposed face. Increase varied angular fragment coverage; no scope change.
